_comment: Central server runtime configuration. It is the LAST config in the central build's
SPA_CONFIG_URLS, where a facility build has config-site.json, so it wins on any key it
redefines. It is never collected into a facility build. Keep it to what is true of
The login and registration keys repeat what config-site.json gave central while central
ran a facility's frontend image, so moving central onto this layer changes nothing there.
The site's billing cash point is deliberately absent: it names a facility's cash point,
chooseLocation.locationTag turns on the MFL facility switcher (LE-324, ADR 0009 §6): the
login picker lists every Health Facility location, searchable by name and MFL code and
narrowed by County and District. Facilities leave it unset and keep the Login Location picker.

logo.alt: Ministry of Health, Republic of Liberia — National Central Server

_comment_service_queues: LE-404. Central runs no patient queues: queue entries are not synced, and central's queue
screen listed every facility's entries to whoever logged in as any facility. The central
build untags Queue Location from every location; this hides the queue app's extensions
(home and app menu links, queue actions) and the start-visit form's queue fields.
_comment_home_dashboards: LE-404. With service-queues gone, /home opens a role's defaultDashboardPerRole entry, else the
first dashboard in this order: sync status, then sync conflicts, then the rest.
